title: Are LLM-Judges Robust to Expressions of Uncertainty? Investigating the effect of Epistemic Markers on LLM-based Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the robustness and bias of LLM-judges when encountering epistemic markers (linguistic expressions of uncertainty). While it mentions the 'principle of honesty' as a goal for LLM alignment and includes a standard ethics statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
